findings.title: The new "moving" refusal has no test
findings.body: The "explains each remaining refusal" table (lines 323-331) lists recording and exporting but not `moving`. The `relocateMoving` string and its `case "moving"` in `relocate-copy.ts:35` are therefore not exercised. The default `relocateFailed` branch and `unknown` have no test either. `relocate.test.ts` also has no `busy: () => "moving"` case for `relocateRefusal` (lines 247-260), so nothing pins that the move lock refuses a relocate. Add `[{ ok: false, reason: "moving" }, /Wait for the move/]` to the table and a `moving` case to the `relocateRefusal` tests.

findings.title: Docs say Change folder… is refused only while a recording or export runs
findings.body: With this PR, `busyNow()` (`main/workspaces/index.ts:66-67`) also returns `"moving"` while a group move runs. `activeTransactionDeps` passes it as `busy`, and `relocateRefusal` (`relocate.ts:24-25`) returns it as the reason. A relocate is now refused during a move as well. This paragraph, and the `workspaces:relocate` row in the spec (line 1302, "while a recording or export runs"), still list only the first two. Add the move so the docs match the new `relocateMoving` message.

contracts.action: Change folder… (workspaces:relocate) is refused while a group move runs
contracts.equivalent_path: The switch transaction (`runSwitch`), which already refused with `moving` through `busyNow`; relocate reuses the same `activeTransactionDeps`.
contracts.before_after: Before, `busy: busyNow` was set only in `runSwitch`'s deps (the removed line at 368), so the relocate deps went through `activeTransactionDeps()` without the move lock. After, `busy` sits in the shared `activeTransactionDeps`, so `relocateRefusal` (before the picker opens) and `relocateWorkspace` (after it) see `moving` and refuse. `switchWorkspace` behaves as before.
contracts.visible_effect: The renderer maps `moving` to "Wait for the move to finish before changing a workspace's folder." via `relocateRefusalMessage`; en and es strings exist.
contracts.failure_mode: `moveRun` is cleared in `finally` (index.ts:218-222), so the lock cannot stick after a throw. If a move starts while the picker is open, `relocateWorkspace` re-checks the lock at its start and refuses. `host.busy()` returns null when idle, so `??` falls through to `moveRun` correctly.

thread_replies.reply: `index.ts:215-217` now logs the error and returns `refuseAll(refusalOfError(error))` instead of a blanket "stale". It is only a mapping check here, since `move-group.ts` is outside this part.
`index.ts:174-177` clears the cached `deviceId` promise when the read rejects, so the next group asks again.

The `refuseAll` contract is unchanged at `index.ts:155-160`: every item goes to `failed` and `skipped` stays empty. You said you changed the comment on `skipped` to match. The types file's `skipped` comment is outside this part's diff, so I did not re-read it.
